Git commit silence alone does not prove absence of semantic work; Action success alone does not prove work quality.
The 2026-10-18T15:29–17:23 interval contains source/rules maintenance commits; subtracting the entire coarse window is deliberately conservative, not exact idle accounting.
No end-to-end host CPU/utilization traces or continuously sampled watchdog evidence for every pause; durations are auditable estimates.
